subject: general
question: The _________ of Gunadhya is written in the Paisachi language.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Brihatkatha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Brihatkatha of Gunadhya is written in the Paisachi language.
 
• Brihatkatha is an ancient Indian epic reported to have been authored by **Guhya in the poorly understood Paisachi language.**
 
• The Brihatkatha existed in the sixth century CE, according to subsequent **Sanskrit poets such as Dain, Subandhu, and Ba.**
 
• **Other estimates place it several centuries before that time period. For example, if the poet Bhsa's account of Udayana (and later by Harsha in Ratnavali) was influenced by Brihatkatha, it had to be older than Bhsa's time — which is unknown, but before the 3rd century CE.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mcchakatika **is a ten-act **Sanskrit drama** claimed to Draka, an ancient playwright who lived in the **5th century CE **and is described in the prologue as a **Kshatriya ruler as well as a Siva devotee who lived for more than 110 years. **
 
• **The Panchatantra** is a collection of interconnected animal fables written in **Sanskrit verse and prose** and structured within a frame plot.
 
• **The Kathsaritsgara** is a well-known collection of Indian stories, fairy tales, and folk tales retold in **Sanskrit by Shaivite Somadeva** in the 11th century.
 
• Gunadya was a scholar in Satvahana King Hala's court.
